title: 第25章 经脉寸断第26章 前三
content_zh:
“这是什么剑法？”
刘逍不可置信的看着这一幕。
“这秦浩，竟然还没完全发挥出他的实力。”
陈运天心中一沉，双眼情不自禁眯了起来。
“足足六十道剑影，每一道剑影威力都媲美《拔剑术》！”
原本神情平静的柳若雪也坐不住了，露出一抹震惊，“秦浩这废物，怎么可能施展出这种高深的剑法？”
“这算是……《拔剑术》增强版？”
杨本洪先是一惊，随即冷笑一声，不屑道：“柳师妹不必大惊小怪，他这一招确实不错，但这一招的核心我已经看出来，无非就是剑术更快，形成无数道剑影而已，你已经在万象殿苦修三月，以你现在的实力，一招便可击败他。”
柳若雪点头，神情恢复平静，笑道：“杨师兄说的有道理，现在回想起来，秦浩这废物从小练剑，剑法高深一些也没什么好奇怪的，那依杨师兄来看，柳狂和秦浩谁能赢？”
杨本洪犹豫了下，低声道：“柳狂若是全力催发暴烈丹，或许可与秦浩一战。”
闻言，柳若雪眉头一皱。
一旦柳狂全力催发暴烈丹，只怕池震衡刹那间就能感应出来，而到时候的后果，只怕柳狂承受不住。
就在两人谈话间，蓦地，从擂台上陡然再次弥漫出一股强大气息。
只见原本一脸震惊的柳狂，此刻已然变得狂怒。
“秦浩，你就是个废物，怎么可能掌握这么高深的剑法！”
“必然是你动用了什么天才战严厉禁止的秘法！
不然，你这种垃圾，绝对不可能拥有这种实力。”
“不过，就算是这样，今日你也注定被我踩在脚下，我会一点点挑断你的脚筋，击碎你的丹田，让你沦为废人中的废人！”
嗡！
柳狂体内暴烈丹的药效已经完全催发。

“好胆！”
几乎同时，一道爆喝声陡然响起。
主席台上，池震衡脸色一沉，浑身散发出恐怖杀机！
原本池震衡就有所怀疑柳狂是否服用禁丹，此刻随着柳狂全部催发暴烈丹药效，池震衡瞬间感应出来，顿时勃然大怒。
不过还没等池震衡动手，最前面的十数道剑影，赫然攻击在柳狂身上。
砰砰砰！
十数道剑影而来，柳狂顿时狰狞着面孔，挥舞大刀疯狂砍杀。
他的刀更快更猛，威力更是增强整整一倍。
只是刹那间，数道剑影，便被柳狂击溃。
然而，击溃数道剑影不算什么，越来越多剑影攻击而来！
“这……我全力催发暴烈丹药效，竟然还是被压制？”
连续击破十数道剑影后，柳狂的力量顿时开始疲软，他脸上的震惊也越发浓烈。
暴烈丹只能持续半刻钟时间，随着时间流逝，药效也会迅速减退。
“你挡不住的。”
content_en:
"What kind of swordsmanship is this?"
Liu Xiao looked at this scene in disbelief.
"This Qin Hao has not yet fully demonstrated his strength."
Chen Yuntian's heart sank, and his eyes couldn't help but narrow.
"There are a total of sixty sword shadows, and the power of each sword shadow is comparable to the "Sword Drawing Technique"!"
Liu Ruoxue, who was originally calm, couldn't sit still anymore and showed a hint of shock, "How could Qin Hao, a loser, display such a profound swordsmanship?"
"This is... an enhanced version of "The Art of Drawing the Sword"?"
Yang Benhong was startled at first, then sneered and said disdainfully: "Junior sister Liu, there is no need to make a fuss. His move is indeed good, but I have already seen the core of this move. It is nothing more than faster sword skills and forming countless sword shadows. You have been practicing hard for three months in the Wanxiang Palace. With your current strength, you can defeat him with one move."
Liu Ruoxue nodded, her expression returned to calm, and she said with a smile: "Senior Brother Yang is right. Looking back now, it is not surprising that Qin Hao, a loser who has been practicing swordsmanship since he was a child, has advanced swordsmanship. So according to Senior Brother Yang, who can win between Liu Kuang and Qin Hao?"
Yang Benhong hesitated for a moment and whispered: "If Liu Kuang uses all his strength to activate the violent pill, he might be able to fight Qin Hao."
Hearing this, Liu Ruoxue frowned.
Once Liu Kuang uses all his strength to activate the violent pill, Chi Zhenheng will be able to sense it in an instant, and Liu Kuang may not be able to bear the consequences.
While the two were talking, suddenly, a powerful aura suddenly filled the air from the ring.
I saw Liu Kuang, who was originally shocked, now becoming furious.
"Qin Hao, you are just a loser, how could you possibly master such a profound swordsmanship!"
"You must have used some genius and strictly prohibited secret method!
Otherwise, it is absolutely impossible for a piece of trash like you to have such strength. "
"However, even so, you are destined to be stepped on by me today. I will break your hamstrings bit by bit, crush your Dantian, and make you a useless person among useless people!"
Buzz!
The effect of the Violent Pill in Liu Kuang's body has been fully activated.
"How brave!"
Almost at the same time, a loud shout suddenly sounded.
On the rostrum, Chi Zhenheng's face darkened, exuding terrifying murderous intent!
Originally, Chi Zhenheng had doubts about whether Liu Kuang had taken the Forbidden Pills. Now as Liu Kuang activated all the effects of the violent pills, Chi Zhenheng sensed it instantly and became furious.
But before Chi Zhenheng could take action, a dozen sword shadows from the front suddenly attacked Liu Kuang.
Bang bang bang!
Dozens of sword shadows came, and Liu Kuang suddenly had a ferocious expression on his face, wielding his sword and slashing wildly.
His sword was faster and stronger, and its power was doubled.
In just an instant, several sword shadows were defeated by Liu Kuang.
However, defeating several sword shadows is nothing, more and more sword shadows are attacking!
"This...I tried my best to activate the effect of the violent pill, but it was still suppressed?"
After defeating dozens of sword shadows in a row, Liu Kuang's strength suddenly began to weaken, and the shock on his face became more intense.
Violent Pill can only last for half a quarter of an hour, and as time goes by, the effect of the medicine will quickly diminish.
"You can't stop it."
